title: ‘Michael 2’ Eyes Filming Start ‘Towards the End of this Year’ or Early 2027 as Lionsgate Teases Release Date
content:
ByRebecca Rubin

Senior Film and Media Reporter

Lionsgate is working on the sequel to “Michael” and hopes to start rolling the cameras soon on the second biopic about Michael Jackson.

The studio hopes to begin production in late 2026 or early 2027, Lionsgate’s motion picture chief Adam Fogelson said onThursday’s earnings call, with the hopes of releasing the final product at the end of next year or in the first half of 2028.

Although the studio waited to officially greenlight the follow-up film, this spring’s “Michael,” which became a box office juggernaut with $1 billion globally, ends with the words “His Story Continues” — making it clear that audiences hadn’t seen the last of the King of Pop.

Antoine Fuqua directed “Michael,” which chronicles the performer’s journey from the Jackson 5 to superstar status. The first film, starring the singer’s real-life nephew Jaafar Jackson, wraps up with 1987’s “Bad” tour. It’s unclear what period in Jackson’s life the second movie will cover, though the filmmakers can mine material including his hit album “Dangerous” as well as the multiple allegations of child sexual abuse that followed Jackson for the rest of his life.

Due to a last-minute legal dispute, “Michael” ended up omitting the most controversial aspects of Jackson’s life. The movie was supposed to address the molestation accusations, but those plans had to be scrapped after attorneys for the Jackson estate discovered a clause in the settlement with one of the accusers that barred the depiction of him in any movie. That forced the filmmakers to retool much of the story, though Fogelson said that some of the material that was cut could be used in the sequel.

“We have a number of sequences, particularly some big musical sequences, that were shot previously, that are almost sure to be incorporated,” Fogelson said on Thursday’s call. “We are mostly focused right now on how to make sure we can deliver, at the right price, the biggest, best sequel. That is what the audience is going to want and deserve after the experience we gave them the first time.”

Fogelson said he’s “not ready to give guidance on the budget yet” but said the company will be able to use some material that was previously shot.
title_zh: 《邁克爾2》(Michael 2) 目標於「今年底」或2027年初開始拍攝，獅門影業(Lionsgate) 也暗示了上映日期。
content_zh:
由瑞貝卡·魯賓（Rebecca Rubin）報導

高級電影與媒體記者

萊昂斯蓋特（Lionsgate）正在製作《麥可（Michael）》的續集，並希望能夠很快開始拍攝這部關於流行音樂之王麥可·傑克森（Michael Jackson）的第二部傳記電影。

萊昂斯蓋特的電影部門負責人亞當·福格爾森（Adam Fogelson）在週四的財報電話會議上表示，該工作室希望在2026年底或2027年初開始製作，並期望在明年年底或2028年上半年推出最終產品。

儘管工作室等待正式批准續集電影，但今年春季上映的《麥可（Michael）》在全球票房達到10億美元，結尾以“他的故事仍在繼續”作結，明確表明觀眾還沒有看到流行音樂之王的最後一面。

安托萬·福夸（Antoine Fuqua）執導的《麥可（Michael）》講述了這位表演者從傑克森五兄弟（Jackson 5）到超級明星的旅程。這部首部電影由歌手的真實侄子賈法·傑克森（Jaafar Jackson）主演，結束於1987年的《壞（Bad）》巡演。目前尚不清楚第二部電影將涵蓋麥可·傑克森的哪個時期，儘管製片人可以挖掘的素材包括他的熱門專輯《危險（Dangerous）》以及隨後伴隨他一生的多起兒童性虐待指控。

由於臨時的法律糾紛，《麥可（Michael）》最終省略了麥可·傑克森生活中最具爭議的方面。這部電影原本打算處理性侵指控，但在傑克森遺產的律師發現與一名指控者的和解條款中禁止在任何電影中描繪他後，這些計畫不得不被取消。這迫使製片人重新調整故事的許多部分，儘管福格爾森表示，一些被刪除的素材可能會在續集中使用。

福格爾森在週四的電話會議上表示：“我們有一些序列，特別是一些大型音樂序列，之前已經拍攝過，幾乎肯定會被納入。”他補充道：“我們目前主要專注於如何確保能以合適的價格交付最大、最好的續集。這是觀眾在第一次的體驗後所想要和應得的。”

福格爾森表示，他“尚未準備好給出預算指導”，但表示公司將能夠使用一些之前拍攝的素材。
